name: Caterpillar - Lafayette IN Large Engine Center
type: Manufacturing plant (large engines; $725M campus expansion underway)

fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (40.4165,-86.8443) is ROOFTOP and lands at the Caterpillar Large Engine Center campus. Locked the 1.6M sq ft main building center at 40.4138,-86.8460. Confirmed: long Caterpillar-branded engine plant building seen from South St in Street View, plus a separate customer/training building to the SE, employee parking, tank farms and a substation on the SW.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck/dock operations are on the south/SE face of the building - a large paved truck yard with canopied dock aprons, trailers, and extensive material laydown reached by a long internal road. The South St (north) frontage is open office/employee access with no fence; the truck area is set deep on internal roads, implying a controlled service gate inside the campus.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No road-visible guard booth - the office frontage is open and the truck gate is internal. Classified remoteGs (controlled service gate, no road-visible booth) at medium-low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The truck approach runs a long internal road from South St to the south dock yard - ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The south truck yard is a very wide paved apron with abundant unused width - room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked across the wide south truck yard plus drop space alongside the dock canopies; capacity ~45.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs diagonally along the SE edge of the property; a spur appears to reach the south dock/laydown area - classified rail-served at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main 1.6M sq ft engine plant plus a separate SE building (customer/training center) on the same campus; the $725M expansion is adding more.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~22 dock doors estimated under canopied aprons on the south face; canopies obscure exact count - low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - the LEC sits within Lafayette's developed south-side commercial/industrial fabric with retail and subdivisions adjacent.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~230 acres for the campus including parking, truck yard and laydown - approximate.
fieldNotes.expansion: A $725M expansion was underway as of the reporting; imagery may predate completed expansion buildings.
